segments.text: Larger Catechism one hundred and eighty
What is it to pray in the name of Christ
To pray in the name of Christ is, in obedience to his command, and in confidence on his promises, to ask mercy for his sake;
not by bare mentioning of his name, but by drawing our encouragement to pray, and our boldness, strength, and hope of acceptance in prayer, from Christ and his mediation.
